name: Kiln-Priest

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The kiln-priest makes three attacks, using Radiant Flame or Mace in any combination.

Actions.name: Radiant Flame
Actions.text: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +9, range 120 ft. 26 (6d6 + 5) Radiant damage.

Actions.name: Spellcasting
Actions.text:
The kiln-priest casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):

- **At Will:** *Light*, *Thaumaturgy*
- **1/Day Each:** *Spirit Guardians*

Actions.name: Fiery Prayer (Recharge 5-6)
Actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw*: DC 16, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* 26 (4d12) Fire damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn. *Success:* Half damage only.
Actions.gmQuote: a kiln priest whose prayers are spoken in fire
Actions.minorClause: , and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn

Actions.name: Mace
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 5 ft. 6 (1d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 5 (2d4) Radiant damage.

Bonus Actions.name: Divine Aid (3/Day)
Bonus Actions.text: The kiln-priest casts *Bless*, *Dispel Magic*, *Healing Word*, or *Lesser Restoration*, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

Traits.name: Searing Prayer-Fire
Traits.text: A creature that touches the kiln-priest or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 10 (3d6) Fire damage.
Traits.gmQuote: a kiln priest whose prayers are spoken in fire
Traits.expresses: prayers spoken as gouts of fire

lore: Kiln-priests are mortals who took vows inside a roaring pottery kiln and were answered, and they now wander the ash-roads seeking converts to feed into their god's fire, believing every soul ignited is a prayer made permanent.
